prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Our client was injured in the incident and has retained us to protect their legal rights and interests. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and refrain from contacting our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or any other means.

We also request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other policy or excess coverage that may apply to this loss. Please provide this information within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

Finally, we ask that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and all correspondence. Destruction or alteration of such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written confirmation that these materials will be preserved.
